RET_EXP_004: SELECT order_id,order_total,CASE WHEN order_total>=100000 THEN 'High' WHEN order_total>=50000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END amount_band FROM orders ORDER BY order_id;
RET_EXP_005: WITH monthly AS (SELECT order_id,DATE_TRUNC('month',item_date)::date event_month,SUM(amount) monthly_amount FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id,DATE_TRUNC('month',item_date)) SELECT order_id,event_month,monthly_amount,LAG(monthly_amount) OVER(PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY event_month) previous_month_amount FROM monthly ORDER BY order_id,event_month;
RET_EXP_006: SELECT order_id,order_item_id,item_date,amount,SUM(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY item_date,order_item_id) running_amount FROM order_items ORDER BY order_id,item_date,order_item_id;
RET_EXP_007: WITH ranked AS (SELECT e.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY amount DESC,order_item_id) rn FROM order_items e) SELECT order_item_id,order_id,amount FROM ranked WHERE rn<=2 ORDER BY order_id,rn;
